fields.label: zersium
fields.description: A dense, dull grey-green mineral ore, heavy for its size and oddly cold to the touch. On its own it is little use; smelted into steel it is what makes durasteel, the hard structural alloy of walls, blast doors and starship plating. It is found in only a few places, and here only in the mountain forge's rock.

fields.label: zersium ore
fields.description: Rock seamed with zersium, the mineral that turns steel into durasteel. The seams show as a cold grey-green sheen in the dark forge rock.

fields.label: phrik
fields.description: A rare, robust alloy that a lightsaber cannot easily cut. It is hammered into staffs and blades for those who must parry a saber, and it is mined, smelted from phrikite, in only a few desert places.

fields.label: phrikite ore
fields.description: Desert rock seamed with phrikite, rare and pale. A little of it, deep in the sands.
